packages.title: Developer Solutions
packages.subtitle: Open-source libraries for Flutter and Dart that we build and maintain. Every package is published on pub.dev under the bangertstudio.kz publisher.

items.pike: Event-driven state management: state changes flow through events instead of direct mutations.
items.apollon: Riverpod-inspired state management with a much smaller API surface — fewer concepts, faster start.
items.depend: Dependency initialization and injection through the widget tree — no codegen, no global singletons.
items.fform: Form builder with typed fields, sync and async validation, and clear error handling.
items.fform_validator: A ready-made set of form checks: email, URL, credit card, IP, length and text format — the usual rules no longer get rewritten in every project.
items.safe_route: Type-safe navigation: route arguments and results are checked at compile time.
items.map_route: Visualizes the app's route graph — see the whole navigation at once while debugging and testing.
items.responsive_breakpoints: Responsive layouts driven by your own breakpoints, declared as a plain enum.
items.enum_picker: A ready-made picker widget for enum values — no boilerplate for every list.
items.herdsman: Centralized Git hooks management for Dart and Flutter projects — the husky analog.
items.markup_analyzer: CLI analyzer for Flutter markup: finds hardcoded strings and styles and generates a report.
items.background_geo_tracker: Background route tracking on iOS and Android: points are collected and uploaded by native code, even while the app is in the background.

home.title: We don't start your project from scratch
home.subtitle: Part of your app is already written, tested and running in real projects. We publish this work in the open — and reuse it when we build your app.

budget.title: Saves budget and time
budget.description: Forms, screens, navigation, adapting to different screen sizes — every app needs the same building blocks. Ours are already built and proven, so you don't pay for work that would otherwise be redone from scratch.

quality.title: You don't have to take our word for it
quality.description: We publish this work in the open: any developer can open the code and see how it's made. Other teams already use it in their own apps — sloppy code doesn't spread like that.
quality.proof: {{perfect}} of our {{total}} solutions earn top marks in an independent automated review: whether there are tests, whether the documentation is written, whether everything works across devices.

freedom.title: No lock-in to us
freedom.description: This work is open and free to use — it isn't locked inside our studio. If you ever want to switch teams, the new one can pick it up and carry on.
